Pattern AI-uditor v0.1.0 - How to install on your Android phone
===============================================================

You were sent a link, not a file. That's the point.
Clicking the link on your phone is the whole install.

THE LINK
--------
https://github.com/truthprojectofficial-max/pattern-auditor/releases/download/v0.1.0/Pattern-AI-uditor-v0.1.0.apk

WHAT IT IS
----------
An Android app called "Pattern AI-uditor". It is a local-only
text scanner. It runs entirely on your phone. It does not connect
to the internet. It does not collect, send, or store anything.

It contains 71 lexical patterns (DD-001..DD-071) and tells you
which ones match a piece of text you give it. That is the whole
product. No ads, no analytics, no account, no in-app purchases.

INSTALL - ON YOUR PHONE
-----------------------
1. Open this link on your Android phone:
   https://github.com/truthprojectofficial-max/pattern-auditor/releases/download/v0.1.0/Pattern-AI-uditor-v0.1.0.apk

2. Chrome will say "this type of file can harm your device".
   That is a generic Android warning for any APK downloaded from
   the web. Tap "Download anyway" / "Keep". The file is signed by
   the developer and the SHA-256 hash matches the one published
   on the GitHub release page (d2f603b8...d92268e).

3. When the download finishes, swipe down from the top of the
   screen and tap the downloaded file. Or open the Files app
   and tap it there.

4. Android will say "For your security, your phone is not
   allowed to install unknown apps from this source." Tap
   "Settings", then turn ON "Allow from this source" for
   Chrome (or whichever app you used). This permission is
   per-app and per-download - you are only allowing Chrome
   to install this one APK, not anything else in the future.

5. Go back. Tap "Install". Wait ~3 seconds.

6. Tap "Open". You are in.

USING IT
--------
- Type or paste up to 50,000 characters into the text box.
  Tap SCAN. Read the result cards.
- OR: in any app, select text, tap Share, pick "Pattern
  AI-uditor" from the share sheet. The text lands in the box
  and the scan runs automatically.

WHAT THE RESULT MEANS
---------------------
Each match is a card showing:
  - the pattern ID and name (e.g. DD-001 - Facade of
    Competence)
  - the exact phrase from your text that triggered the match
  - the indicator (the keyword/phrase the pattern looks for)
  - the rule explanation
  - the ruleset version

What the result does NOT mean:
  - It does not mean the text is a lie.
  - It does not mean the writer is deceitful.
  - It does not measure truth, intent, or diagnosis.
  - "No configured pattern detected" does not mean the text
    is honest. It just means none of the 71 lexical indicators
    fired.

IF SOMETHING GOES WRONG
-----------------------
- App won't install: the file may be incomplete. Re-download
  from the link above. If Chrome's "Open after download"
  jumped straight to installer, the file is ~5.7 MB; if yours
  is smaller, the download was cut off.
- App crashes on launch: take a screenshot. Send it to the
  person who sent you the link. The developer will fix it.
- App says "Nothing to scan": the share didn't carry text.
  Try a different app, or copy the text and paste it into
  the field.

UNINSTALL
---------
Long-press the app icon -> App info -> Uninstall.
This removes the app. Nothing is left on your phone; nothing
was sent anywhere.
